text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah, excuse me, sir!
A seat just opened up, please feel free to take it!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Man
text_block_list.text:
! That's true.
Well then, I'll gratefully... *heave-ho*.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Man
text_block_list.text: Phew... You're right about that. Here I thought I was still young, but I'm an old man already, huh.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah...!
I'm so sorry! You just looked so full of
energy, and, well, um...!
Kitasan Black couldn't find the words to cover for them and ended up mentally exhausted.
